screenshot_review.method: Inspected all full-run contact sheets and final corrected captures; inspected representative individual images.
screenshot_review.color_fix_rerun: Reviewed all 13 rerendered entries, including all 10 scenes that resize textures.

checks: move exported package and load with portable confinement

gpu_color_upload.cases: RGB888 / RGBA8888 / ARGB32 premultiplied; original size, downscale, upscale; RGBA GPU readback and vertical orientation

remaining_limitations: Source authored camera framing is preserved, including the close ceiling view in test.scene and different authored/standalone Jinx orientations.
Quad emitters are two double-sided emissive triangles; ideal distant light is a 0.1-degree disk with matched axial irradiance.
Current native pinhole camera, tone mapping, RR, medium/BSDF behavior and background visibility apply; per-scene notes identify source settings that differ.
RGBA8 derived texture precision and filtering differ slightly; packed roughness floor is 1/255 rather than source 0.001.
Existing degenerate source triangle normals are reported for Mustang variants, rank3police and staircase; no geometry was omitted.
GPU captures use a 64-full-frame accumulation limit and 96 presentation events; noise remains and results are not pixel-identical to the source renderer.

corrections.issue: Qt resized material image channel order and premultiplied alpha
corrections.cause: QImage smooth scaling can return ARGB32_Premultiplied; uploading its bytes as GL_RGBA swaps red/blue and treats premultiplied colors as straight.
corrections.fix: Convert to Format_RGBA8888 after mirroring and scaling, immediately before GPU upload.
corrections.previous_conclusion: The earlier attribution of color loss to the default HDR was incorrect; all resized-texture captures have been superseded.
